description: Runs Data Backup Manager recovery simulators and a generated library-wide Program Runtime child-envelope matrix with per-program capability requirements and observable fallbacks.

levels.name: Fault injection unavailable
levels.description: The owner simulator suite could not execute.

levels.name: Recovery loop exercised
levels.description: The simulated safe and risky recovery routes execute through their owners.
exit_criteria: Safe remount and risky confirmation paths pass.
levels.capability_summary: The recovery loop is exercised under simulated faults.

levels.name: Receipt matrix verified
levels.description: Backup/restore owner tests pass and fixture receipts cannot qualify native cells.
exit_criteria: Receipt matrix regenerates and checks successfully.
levels.capability_summary: Simulated recovery and receipt-only qualification checks pass.

capabilities.label: Owner recovery loop
capabilities.description: Safe remount and risky repair decision/callback through control-plane and DBM owners.

levels.name: Simulated
levels.description: Safe and risky recovery owner paths pass with fake volume observers.

levels.name: Owner loop verified
levels.description: Owner tests pass and simulated receipts preserve native qualification boundaries.

capabilities.label: Child-envelope fault matrix
capabilities.description: Generated faults exercise the production helper for every adopting library program and record its declared capability requirements and observable fallback.

levels.name: Matrix unavailable
levels.description: The generated matrix cannot be executed.

levels.name: Matrix executed
levels.description: Every generated program and fault row executes.
exit_criteria: Every row reports the expected helper semantics.

levels.name: Matrix verified
levels.description: Every generated row passes with content-addressed parent contracts.
exit_criteria: No row differs from its expected status and error class.
